output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Stripe does not appear to have a publicly announced CTO. Its most recent CTO, Rahul Patil, left Stripe in October 2025 to join Anthropic as Chief Technology Officer (announced by Anthropic on October 7, 2025). Patil had become Stripe CTO in 2024, succeeding David Singleton, who stepped down in August 2024 after seven years to start his own company. Since Patil's departure, Stripe's engineering organization is overseen by Will Gaybrick, President of Technology and Business, and an executive-team listing updated October 15, 2026 shows no chief technology officer among Stripe's nine tracked leaders.
caveats: Stripe itself has not publicly named a successor CTO after Rahul Patil's October 2025 departure; the conclusion that the role is vacant or unfilled publicly rests on Stripe's executive team listing (no CTO among 9 tracked leaders as of 2026-10-15) and the absence of any appointment announcement, so Stripe could have named a new CTO without broad coverage.

Some search-engine AI summaries still describe Rahul Patil as Stripe's CTO in 2026; that is outdated and contradicted by Anthropic's own official announcement that he joined Anthropic as CTO in October 2025.
